snp1.9:1.1: Hemavatasutta. "Ajja pannaraso uposatho, iti Sātāgiro yakkho divyā ratti upaṭṭhitā, anomanāmaṃ satthāraṃ handa passāma Gotamaṃ". || ||
snp1.9:2.1: "Kacci mano supaṇihito iti Hemavato yakkho sabbabhūtesu tādino, kacci iṭṭhe aniṭṭhe ca saṃkapp' assa vasīkatā". || ||
snp1.9:3.1: "Mano c' assa supaṇihito iti Sātāgiro yakkho sabbabhūtesu tādino, atho iṭṭhe aniṭṭhe ca saṃkapp' assa vasījatā", || ||
snp1.9:4.1: "Kacci adinnaṃ nādiyati, iti Hemavato yakkho kacci pāṇesu saññato, kacci ārā pamādamhā, kacci jhānaṃ na riñcati". || ||
snp1.9:5.1: "Na so adinnaṃ ādiyati, iti Sātāgiro yakkho atho pāṇesu saññato, atho ārā pamādamhā, Buddho jhānaṃ na riñcati". || ||
snp1.9:6.1: "Kacci musā na bhaṇati,| iti Hemavato yakkho Kacci na khīṇavyappatho, Kacci vebhūtiyan nāha, kacci samphaṃ na bhāsati". || ||
snp1.9:7.1: "Musā ca so na bhaṇati, iti Sātāgiro yakkho atho na khīṇavyappatho, atho vebhūtiyan nāha, mantā atthaṃ so bhāsati". || ||
snp1.9:8.1: "Kacci na rajjati kāmesu, iti Hemavato yakkho kacci cittaṃ anāvilaṃ, kacci mohaṃ atikkanto, kacci dhammesu cakkhumā". || ||
snp1.9:9.1: "Na so rajjati kāmesu, iti Sātāgiro yakkho atho cittaṃ anāvilaṃ, sabbamohaṃ atikkanto. Buddho dhammesu cakkhumā". || ||
snp1.9:10.1: "Kacci vijjāya sampanno, iti Hemavato yakkho kacci saṃsuddhacāraṇo, kacci 'ssa āsavā khīṇā, kacci n' atthi punabbhavo". || ||
snp1.9:11.1: "Vijjāya-m-eva sampanno, iti Sātāgiro yakkho atho saṃsuddhacāraṇo, sabb' assa āsavā khīṇā, n' atthi tassa punabbhavo. || || A.
snp1.9:12.1: Sampannaṃ munino cittaṃ kammanā vyappathena ca, vijjācaraṇasampannaṃ dhammato naṃ pasaṃsasi. || || B.
snp1.9:13.1: Sampannaṃ munino cittaṃ kammanā vyappathena ca, vijjācaraṇasampannaṃ dhammato anumodasi. || ||
snp1.9:14.1: Sampannaṃ munino cittaṃ kammanā vyappathena ca, vijjācaraṇasampannaṃ handa passāma Gotamaṃ. || ||
snp1.9:15.1: Eṇijaṃghaṃ kisaṃ dhīraṃ appāhāraṃ alolupaṃ muniṃ vanasmiṃ jhāyantaṃ ehi passāma Gotamaṃ. || ||
snp1.9:16.1: Sīhaṃ v' ekacaraṃ nāgaṃ kāmesu anapekhinaṃ upasaṃkamma pucchāma maccupāsā pamocanaṃ. || ||
snp1.9:17.1: Akkhātāraṃ pavattāraṃ sabbadhammāna pāraguṃ Buddhaṃ verabhayātītam mayaṃ pucchāma Gotamaṃ", || ||
snp1.9:18.1: "Kismiṃ loko samuppanno, iti Hemavato yakkho kismiṃ kubbati santhavaṃ, kissa loko upādāya kismiṃ loko vihaññati". || ||
snp1.9:19.1: "Chassu loko samuppanno, Hemavatā ti Bhagavā chassu kubbati santhavaṃ, channam eva upādāya chassu loko vihaññati". || ||
snp1.9:20.1: "Kataman taṃ upādānaṃ, yattha loko vihaññati, niyyānaṃ pucchito brūhi: kathaṃ dukkhā pamuccati". || ||
snp1.9:21.1: "Pañca kāmagunā loke manochaṭṭhā paveditā, ettha chandaṃ virājetvā evaṃ dukkhā pamuccati. || ||
snp1.9:22.1: Etaṃ lokassa niyyānaṃ akkhātaṃ vo yathātathaṃ, etam vo aham akkhāmi: evaṃ dukkhā pamuccati". || ||
snp1.9:23.1: "Ko sū 'dha taratī oghaṃ, ko 'dha tarati aṇṇavaṃ, {appatiṭṭhe} anālambe ko gambhīre na sīdati". || ||
snp1.9:24.1: "Sabbadā sīlasampanno paññavā susamāhito ajjhattacintī satimā oghaṃ tarati duttaraṃ. || ||
snp1.9:25.1: Virato kāmasaññya sabbasaṃyojanātigo nandībhavaparikkhīṇo, so gambhīre na sīdati". || ||
snp1.9:26.1: "Gambhīrapaññaṃ nipuṇatthadassiṃ akiñcanaṃ kāmabhave asattaṃ taṃ passatha sabbadhi vippamuttaṃ dibbe pathe kamamānaṃ mahesiṃ. || ||
snp1.9:27.1: Anomanāmaṃ nipuṇatthadassiṃ paññādadaṃ kāmālaye asattaṃ taṃ passatha sabbaviduṃ sumedhaṃ ariye pathe kamamānaṃ mahesiṃ. || ||
snp1.9:28.1: Suddiṭṭhaṃ vata no ajja suppabhātaṃ suhuṭṭhitaṃ, yaṃ addasāma Sambuddhaṃ oghatiṇṇam anāsavaṃ. || ||
snp1.9:29.1: Ime dasasatā yakkhā iddhimanto yasassino sabbe taṃ saraṇaṃ yanti, tvan no satthā anuttaro. || ||
snp1.9:30.1: Te mayaṃ vicarissāma gāmā gāmaṃ nagā nagaṃ namassamānā Sambuddhaṃ dhammassa ca sudhammatan" ti || || Hemavatasuttaṃ niṭṭhitaṃ.
